✰ ABOUT ME ✰
➭ My name is Lennon and I'm a lady rabbit!
➭ I'm 9-years-old and my momma, Lorelei Carlson, makes videos 
to help others learn about rabbit care. 
➭ L.A. born and raised 🌴
➭ Spayed & Potty trained
➭ Breed: Havana mix / Vienna gene

✰ FOLLOW US ✰
➭ Lennon's instagram: http://www.instagram.com/lennonthebunny
➭ Lorelei's instagram: http://www.instagram.com/loreleicarlson
➭ 2nd youtube channel: https://www.youtube.com/LoreleiCarlsonTV

✰ IMPORTANT ✰ 
➭ Bunnies are lots of hard work and they deserve love and respect
➭ They are not recommended for small children 
➭ They don't belong in cages
➭ Consider adopting from your local rabbit rescue or shelter  

✰ DISCLAIMER ✰ 
➭ Lorelei is not a vet. Please contact a rabbit-savvy vet for any medical emergencies. 
➭ Always monitor your rabbits around new products or environmental changes.

* Want us to try your product? Send us an email! *
